trigger_or_action.reason: Call to increaseLiquidity with deadline=block.timestamp; MEV bot holds tx until unfavorable conditions.

direct_effect.reason: Expiration check always true; tx executes with stale pricing, enabling MEV arbitrage extraction.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected block.timestamp<=deadline expiration guarantee vs actual always-true check, derived from Uniswap V3 model.

summary: Report identifies the vulnerable function, the hardcoded deadline trigger, the resulting loss of expiration protection enabling MEV, and the violated Uniswap V3 deadline safety model.
